The main phases of GWZ alloy are α-Mg and Mg3RE.

In Al-GWZ alloy, the generation of blocky Al2RE phase with the size of 3~7 um is promoted by the inclusion of Al element.
Meanwhile, the Al promotes the generation of lamellar LPSO phase, which well corresponds to the XRD results.
After homogenization (Fig. 3(b)), the diffraction peak of Mg3RE disappears and only the peaks of α-Mg and LPSO phase occur in the GWZ alloy.
In Fig. 3(b), the diffraction peaks of LPSO phases in GWZ alloy are mainly concentrated in the 2θ range of 25~40°, which match the 14H-LPSO phase.
Whereas those diffraction peaks of AlN/Al-GWZ composites appear in the 2θ range of 5~10°, which correspond to the 18R-LPSO phase (Fig. 3(c)).
the Al2RE particles in the Al-GWZ alloy show the size of 3–7 um without coarsening in the matrix, indicating that Al2RE is thermally stable during the solid-solution.

The strengthening effect was primarily originated from the AlN particles, Al2RE and LPSO phases in the 2AlN/Al-GWZ composite.
